# 🧭 dsh-retrace

> A session time machine for DeepSeek Harness — a personal compatibility-fix fork of
> yamingmou/dsh
-retrace. Current version: **0.4.83**.

Recall a whole turn, edit-and-resend a past prompt, or regenerate a reply — while the
conversation s

tate and the workspace files it touched are versioned together. Every rollback
is a legal append-onl
y session event, so the log stays clean and `/compact` keeps working.
**简体中文** · 中文详细说明
## 📦 Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart DSH (and refresh the page) after installing or updating — a running app does not
hot-load bu

ndles. If `dsh` is not on your PATH, prefix the command with
`npx --yes -p @deepseek-ai/dsh`.

> This fork is not published to npm under its own name; `add dsh-retrace` installs the
> upstream pa

ckage and does **not** include the fixes below. Install from GitHub, or from a
> local checkout with
`dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-retrace`.
## ✨ Features

- **↩ Recall** — remove an entire turn (prompt + reply + tool rows) from both model context
and the

chat view; the original prompt is echoed back into the composer.
- **✎ Edit & resend** — edit a past

user message in place and re-answer, with a collapsible
"original prompt" reference.
- **↻ Regenera

te** — keep the prompt, hide the previous reply, and let the agent answer again.
- **🕘 Version timel

ine** — every rollback becomes a version (kind / time / message count /
file changes), pushed live v

ia `session/projection`.
- **↩️ Artifact rollback** — conversation only, files only, or both, with a

dry-run preview;
git when the boundary recorded the exact committed bytes, content-addressed snapsh

ots
otherwise; a rollback is itself a new version.
- **🧭 Fork map & lineage** — visualize branch poi

nts and parent-session lineage.
- **🗂️ Session archaeology CLI** — read-only index / query / extract

/ file-history over
persisted session logs.
## 🔄 Recent changes (0.4.50 → 0.4.83)

- **0.4.83** — recall works again in sessions whose images were offloaded. The official replay
prefl

ight now hands the host registry's message projections (`sessions.messageProjections`)
to `Session.f

romRestore`, so a plugin-owned message change such as `image/offload` has its
interpreter during rep

lay. Passing only five arguments made the replay reject a session the
host was still serving — `inva

lid seed event at index N: session event "image/offload"
requires a message projection` — and every

recall in that session failed. When no definition
exists anywhere the preflight still refuses, so th
e gate stays honest.

- **0.4.82** — port the request-scope and raw-input hardening onto the 0.4.81 line.
`x-retrace-confi

g` is now request-scoped through `AsyncLocalStorage` instead of a sticky
per-session map, so a valid

header can no longer leak into later missing/malformed requests
and a partial header no longer inhe

rits stale fields; `prewrite` is host-only again (it was
request-settable, which let a client disabl

e the marker guard). `handleSnapshot` fails closed:
no sessions service → 503 `sessions-unavailable`

, unknown session → 404 `session-not-found`,
and neither touches the snapshot store. Fold endpoints

require raw safe-integer
`start`/`end` (with `end >= start`) through a shared `isFoldRange`; `Number

()` previously
coerced `null`/`''`/`false` to 0 and `true` to 1, folding the first node. `store-cli`

writes
through a UUID temp file opened `wx`, fsyncs before rename, fsyncs the parent directory
afte

r, and reports `store-commit-uncertain` when the commit landed but the directory sync
failed. `git-a

dapter` reads `ls-tree -z` (a path with a newline no longer breaks the parse),
`artifact-store.read`

honours `maxBytes`, and the client only restores recalled images when
the text actually landed in t

xBytes`, and the client only restores recalled images when
the text actually landed in the composer.

- **0.4.81** — pin the deprecated synchronous session readers so no new call sites appear.
Upstream

marks `Session.eventAt()` / `snapshotEvents()` / `ownEvents()` as deprecated and
prohibits new calls

*and* new wrappers around them; this repo's whole read path sits on them
[该节后续省略]
## ⚙️ Settings → Recall
| Setting | Default | Notes |
| Show original-prompt reference | on | Collapsible reference under a resent message (display only).

|
| Start from a new conversation after edit | off | Hide everything before the edited prompt as we

ll. |
| Hide replaced messages by marker | on | Auto-degrades to visible when a marker would hide >4

0% of the conversation. |
| Version & artifact snapshots | on | Records a version per rollback; off

= context-only rollback. |
| Git integration | on | Uses git when the workspace is a repo; one-click

init is available in the timeline. |
| Version retention limit | 50 | Keeps snapshots for the most
recent N versions (1–1000); the timeline keeps its own records (up to 200). |
## ⚠️ Requirements & limits

- Only user messages can be edited; recall works for both user and assistant messages.
- The agent m

ust be idle. A running reply is cancelled and awaited, up to 15 seconds
(`agent-stop-timeout`).
- Re

call / edit target the active model surface: compressed or already-shadowed messages are
rejected (`

target-shadowed`), and unreadable or sparse session events report
`log-unavailable`.
- Artifact roll

back refuses to run when the worktree has uncommitted changes
(`working-tree-dirty`); commit or disc

ard them first.
- Regenerate resends only the text part of the prompt; prompts with images fall back

.
- Regenerate resends only the text part of the prompt; prompts with images fall back to
text-only.

This repo ships the source, not the private build toolchain:

checkout; run t

hem with plain `node` (there is no `node_modules` — don't run
`pnpm install` / `pnpm build`).
- Clie

nt changes must be made in **both** `lib/client.js` and `lib/client.bundle.js`, and both
must pass `

node --check`.
